procedure: Run the Vite development server with live tmux-backed data.
Open SessionDetail in the recorded browser viewport and observe onCommitFiberRoot.
Capture SessionDetailView actualDuration for each operation five times.
Use the peak commit in each repetition and nearest-rank p95 across the five samples.
Save candidate measurements as a separate artifact with its own measurementCommit.
